Transparency obligations under Article 50 of the AI Act

This page provides answers to frequently asked questions related to the Guidelines on Article 50 of the AI Act.

Who is a provider of an AI system?

Providers are natural or legal persons that develop an AI system or have it developed and place it on the market under their own name or trademark.

Deployers must inform individuals when they are exposed to emotion recognition systems, deepfakes or AI-generated text on matters of public interest.
